# bayesian-optimizer

> Bayesian optimisation of expensive black-box functions with a hand-written Gaussian process and expected improvement or lower confidence bound Python package `trysac-bayesian-optimizer`, import name `bayesian_optimizer`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
